acceptance.given: An external process or aggregate reaches its configured time or output budget limit.

oracle.expected: The bounded execution reaches a deterministic unsuccessful terminal result.
forbidden: Budget exhaustion is classified as successful.
Budget exhaustion is treated as an indeterminate success or omitted outcome.
oracle.observable: A real budget-exhaustion execution is evaluated through the external-process and aggregate terminal-state path.

acceptance.then: The budget-exhausted execution has an unsuccessful terminal result.
acceptance.when: A configured execution budget is exhausted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the authored S11 behavior selector with a process or aggregate that exhausts its configured time or output budget and observe the unsuccessful terminal outcome.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify a time- or output-budget-exhausted external process or aggregate as a deterministic unsuccessful terminal result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore only Toolchain execution-result handling; no Phase service state or schema changes are permitted.

slice_hint.state_transition: An external process or aggregate reaches a time or output budget limit -> The budget-exhausted execution has an unsuccessful terminal result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A budget-exhaustion run terminates deterministically as unsuccessful and is never published as successful, indeterminate success, or omitted.

acceptance.given: The six frozen Matrix Cases and independently identifiable Stable and Candidate subjects are prepared for replay-matrix evaluation.

oracle.expected: Every Matrix Case has separate execution records for both Stable and Candidate subjects, and the aggregate fails for any missing execution.
forbidden: A Matrix Case executes only one subject.
A Matrix Case does not execute either subject.
oracle.observable: Replay-matrix execution records enumerate both subject executions for each of the six Matrix Cases.

acceptance.then: Every Matrix Case has execution coverage for both subjects.
acceptance.when: The S41 replay-matrix selector runs the six Matrix Cases.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S41 matrix test with one Matrix Case missing either Stable or Candidate execution; aggregate validation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each of the six Matrix Cases to execute both Stable and Candidate subjects and reject the aggregate if either execution is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-state or schema migration; rollback restores prior matrix-execution behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix evaluation without established two-subject coverage -> all six Matrix Cases have Stable and Candidate execution records.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S41 selector verifies both subject executions in all six Matrix Cases and rejects any missing execution.

acceptance.given: A retained evaluation-seed manifest contains the three required named seed records, with one otherwise-valid record isolated to have applicability absent or false.

oracle.expected: RMAP-S2 seed validation rejects the isolated record and does not accept it into the evaluation set.
forbidden: Accepting a seed without applicability metadata.
Accepting a seed whose applicability is false.
oracle.observable: The validation error/result for the isolated seed record identifies applicability as missing or not true.

acceptance.then: Only a record with explicit true applicability can pass the retained-seed applicability check.
acceptance.when: RMAP-S2 validation evaluates a retained evaluation seed.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the existing RMAP-S2 validator test with an otherwise-valid retained seed whose applicability is first omitted and then false; each variant must be rejected by the applicability check.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the RMAP-S2 retained-evaluation-seed validator so every required seed record must carry applicability set explicitly to true; absent or false applicability is rejected before the record can be accepted.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The manifest remains non-authorizing and preserves the three required named records; rollback removes only the explicit applicability enforcement and its corresponding manifest fields.

slice_hint.state_transition: A retained seed with absent or false applicability transitions to rejected; a seed with explicit true applicability remains eligible for subsequent RMAP-S2 validation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted RMAP-S2 validator test proves that omitted applicability and false applicability are rejected, while the complete manifest with explicit true applicability passes the applicability check.

acceptance.given: The required validator capability is absent from the configured Toolchain validator capability set, and the replay/validation command is invoked for the candidate package.

oracle.expected: The invocation exits unsuccessfully with a deterministic missing-capability diagnostic, produces no Replay Result artifact, and does not select or substitute any other validator capability.
forbidden: Proceeding as if validation succeeded when the required capability is absent.
Selecting or substituting another validator capability.
Emitting a Replay Result artifact for the rejected invocation.
oracle.observable: Process exit status and stderr or structured diagnostic show fail-closed missing-validator-capability rejection; the expected Replay Result output path remains absent.

acceptance.then: Run the targeted replay validator test against a configuration with the required validator capability removed and inspect exit status, diagnostic category, validator identity, and Replay Result artifact absence.
acceptance.when: When the required validator capability is missing during Toolchain replay validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke the replay/validation entry point with the required validator capability absent; expect deterministic unsuccessful termination and no Replay Result.
Configure the missing-capability case so any fallback or substituted validator is observable; fail if a different validator is selected or validation proceeds.
Check the run output after rejection; fail if any Replay Result artifact is created for the missing-capability invocation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain replay validation path fail closed when its required validator capability is unavailable: report the missing capability, avoid validator substitution, terminate unsuccessfully, and emit no Replay Result. The test asserts this behavior end to end.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay interfaces and successful-capability behavior; restrict the change to missing-capability fail-closed handling and its deterministic diagnostic.

slice_hint.state_transition: required validator capability present -> normal validation; required validator capability absent -> unsuccessful rejection with no Replay Result and no fallback validator selection
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted test observes non-zero termination, a missing-validator-capability diagnostic, no substituted validator identity, and no Replay Result artifact.
